Values.2: Prohibiting of movement : 10 cycles of motorised opening/closing of the motorised tailgate carried out in energy economy mode
Values.3: Stopping or prohibiting of movement : Motorisation of the motorised tailgate inhibited by the user
Values.4: Stopping or prohibiting of movement : starting of the engine
Values.5: Stopping or prohibiting of movement : Presence of a trailer
Values.6: Prohibiting of movement : Thermal protection of the motorised tailgate gas struts activated
Values.7: Stopping or prohibiting of movement : Detection of an obstacle by the anti-pinch sensor(s)

Values.10: Stopping or prohibiting of movement : Fault codes present
Values.11: Prohibiting of movement : Rejection of programming of the maximum opening position of the motorised tailgate
Values.12: Prohibiting of movement : Rejection of clearing of the programming of the maximum opening position of the motorised tailgate
Values.14: Stopping or prohibiting of movement : Vehicle locked or motorised tailgate lock still closed
Values.15: Stopping or prohibiting of movement : Body CAN dormant

Fault in the configuration of the vehicle body type and of the anti-pinch sensors

Motorised tailgate lock closing to first notch status switch signal fault
Motorised tailgate left-hand gas strut position sensor signal fault

Motorised tailgate left-hand gas strut motor control fault
Motorised tailgate right-hand gas strut motor control fault
Upper anti-pinch sensor signal fault
Motorised tailgate motorised opening request fault (Button on the motorised tailgate)
Motorised tailgate motorised closing request fault (Button on the inside of the motorised tailgate)
Motorised tailgate closing assistance module control fault
Fault not recorded in the built-in systems interface faults log
Fault: no communication with BSI
Body / passenger compartment CAN
Fault: ECU not communicating on the CAN
Fault: absence of communication with the trailer relay unit
